description: Asks how Database.Execute (dbFailOnError) answers INSERT spellings into U (ID Long primary key, K Text(50) with a unique index), in order, each followed by RecordsAffected and DBEngine.Errors: VALUES with one row, several parenthesised rows and a trailing comma, no column list, a missing or extra value, a repeated or unknown column, an unknown table, no INTO, brackets, an expression, a scalar subquery and a domain function as a value, Null and empty text twice, a number and text for the wrong column type, a fractional and an out-of-range key, a 60-character value in a Text(50) column, INSERT ... SELECT with a TOP, UNION and GROUP BY source, a SELECT without FROM, a duplicate key from a second SELECT, and two statements in one text. Finally every row of U is read. Fixture r-def-expr-sql-main is opened on a writable fresh copy through DAO.DBEngine.120; engine version and the loaded modules (once) are recorded; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field.
retentionNote: Designed r-def-expr-sql probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
